blockers.title: A delete on one phone and an insert under the deleted parent on the other leave an orphan row; the course export then fails on both phones, whichever uploads first
blockers.evidence: The server has no foreign keys; a device deletes only the children it knows, and a new child has its own key-based id, so neither the conditioned delete nor keep_latest_edit can catch it. Scratch runs on ea1b310 with the milestone's own server model, both orders: O1 phone B at 09:00 puts student-3 in crew-2, phone A at 10:00 removes crew-2: both phones have crews ['crew-1'] and crewMembers [{crewId: 'crew-2', personId: 'student-3'}]; readCrewPlan succeeds with resolvedConflicts 0 and student-3 silently drops out; exportCourseArchive throws on both phones. O2 phone B evaluates student-3, phone A deletes student-3: an evaluation of a missing student on both phones, export throws in both orders. No notice.
blockers.reproduction: Reviewer scratch orph.test.ts (placementConvergence harness plus 'orphans, reversed %s').

importantFindings.title: The remaining gap of SC-B4-2: a later delete loses to an earlier whole-row edit uploaded after it, and the row comes back with no notice; recorded only in the backlog, it needs the owner's acceptance or tombstones
importantFindings.evidence: Round-1 fuzz (seed 360423565) re-run with the round-2 rules: 3 of 200 rounds wrong (was 42), all this case (rounds 51, 108, 141). With whole-row edits, an edit made before another phone's delete brings back a deleted student, crew or evaluation; a re-insert is not counted as superseded.

importantFindings.title: One run of 'a refusal arriving after the course was erased is not kept' failed
importantFindings.evidence: Full run of b4-uploads.spec.ts: 7 passed, 1 failed (toBeVisible); alone twice it passed. The working tree was changing during the run; file it if it repeats on a clean tree.

qolFindings.title: Equal timestamps go to whichever phone uploads last
qolFindings.evidence: keep_latest_edit skips only when new < old; TOUCH is max(now, stored), so two phones editing a row last written by a phone whose clock is ahead write the same future stamp.
